hook: Bank of America arm takes *10 lakh sq ft* in Madhapur
hook_b: Bank of America arm takes *10 lakh sq ft* in Madhapur
tldr: BA Continuum India has leased 10.1 lakh sq ft (chargeable) in Building No. 1 of Mindspace Cyberabad, Madhapur, for 12 years, per Propstack data cited by a Times of India report.

beats.what: The lease covers the ground floor and floors 7 to 17, with over 7 lakh sq ft of carpet area.
beats.why: Starting rent is Rs 82 per sq ft a month (about Rs 8.29 crore a month), rising 15% every three years.
beats.care: It is one of the biggest office deals Hyderabad has seen, following Accenture and Uber leases.

event.label: 10.1 lakh sq ft lease at Mindspace

effects.label: More office space filling in Madhapur

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: BA Continuum also reportedly paid a security deposit of Rs 49.72 crore.

cards.q: Would a big new Madhapur office change your job hunt?

qs: How many jobs could 7 lakh sq ft of carpet area hold?

facts.t: Accenture leased over *1 million sq ft* at Aparna Technopolis for 10 years at around Rs 74 per sq ft.
Uber took over *9 lakh sq ft* at Meenakshi Eco Park for 10 years.

viz.verdict: Biggest of the recent deals named; good for office jobs, cost borne by the firm
Rent steps up 15% every three years

steps.e: Rent starts at Rs 82/sq ft/month (~Rs 8.29 cr)

watch: Rent payments start in January 2027; the lease runs 12 years.
